 What you need to know during Medicare open enrollment 
 Kevin Dorr with Mapping Medicare joins John Redfield to discuss Medicare phone scams, misleading benefit advertisements, and changes to hospital insurance networks during open enrollment. (wluc) By John Redfield Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 7:36 AM EST | Updated : 5 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MARQUETTE, Mich. (WLUC) - Medicare open enrollment is underway, and there are a few things seniors should keep in mind when choosing their healthcare coverage.
 Kevin Dorr with Mapping Medicare joined John Redfield to discuss three important topics: suspicious Medicare phone calls, advertisements offering free grocery or money cards, and hospitals leaving insurance networks.
 Dorr encourages seniors to be cautious of unexpected phone calls, understand what benefits their plans actually offer, and make sure their preferred doctors and hospitals are still covered.
 Medicare open enrollment runs through December 7, giving seniors time to review their options and make changes to their coverage.
